projects.name: MMORPG Shop
details: Independently built a Go-based MMORPG shop composed of 5 domain microservices for authentication, player, item, inventory, and payment management.
Implemented Kafka-driven buy and sell workflows that update player balances and inventories, with persisted offset tracking and compensating rollback events for failed transactions.
Exposed REST and gRPC APIs backed by isolated MongoDB databases, securing access with JWT authentication, role-based authorization, and request validation.

contributions.name: Goyave
details: Contributed custom ListenConfig support for advanced server configuration.

contributions.name: Pruna
details: Migrated project-wide static type checking from mypy to ty and updated Python annotations.
Building a configurable Kotlin/Ktor service scaffold template for Agoda teams, supporting REST, GraphQL, BFF, database, testing, and local-development options.
Added GraphQL client support, client-profile metrics, and parent-context propagation for Tempo to the Kotlin/Ktor service template ecosystem.
Replacing ArchUnit with Konsist to express Kotlin-native architecture rules with less boilerplate and clearer tests.
Collaborated with the team to deliver the Rakuten OTA integration across backend microservices and the BFF, supporting property-data mapping and validation.
Developed unit and integration tests for the Rakuten import flow, validating new mapping and validation logic across affected backend services.
Investigated import failures during the A/B rollout by comparing Rakuten payloads, requests, and Grafana logs. Identified missing data fields that caused unhandled errors.
Built a full-stack professor-facing exam-management proof of concept with manual, Excel-import, and AI-generated rubric workflows, backed by 26 integration tests.
Integrated GPT-4o and Gemini through Vercel AI SDK for rubric generation and AI-assisted grading with score explanations, batch processing, and human review.
Protected professor-provided AI keys with AES-256-GCM encryption and implemented role-based access control and input validation.
